name: FreeGenVideo
tagline: Create short videos from text prompts or reference images in a browser
description: FreeGenVideo lets creators explore short videos from a written prompt or a reference image in the browser. Text-to-video starts with a scene and motion description; image-to-video starts with an uploaded image and optional motion instructions. No account or app installation is required. The free daily allowance is one video, resetting at 00:00 UTC, with paid options for additional usage. It can be used to explore social clip ideas, product reveals and story concepts. Available output settings depend on the current model, and users should review results before publishing.
startingPrice: 1 free video per day; paid options
